extDescription.message: Save and restore windows and tabs, and keep sessions in sync across browsers through Google Drive, Dropbox, pCloud or a local sync folder.

providerFolder.message: Local sync folder (Google Drive for desktop / pCloud Drive / Dropbox ...)

needsPermissionLabel.message: Access to the sync folder is required.

pcloudCaptionLabel.message: Register an app at pCloud My Applications.
